components.name: o3de-rpm
components.description: O3DE RPM packaging spec (versioned package: o3de2610)

component.name: o3de2610
component.description: Open 3D Engine 26.10 line: real-time, multi-platform 3D engine. First line built against system Qt6 + the Stage-1 system-library swap set (no bundled Qt).

externalReferences.comment: Upstream engine source tarball (CycloneDX distribution for the engine component).
COPR stabilization channel (pre-release engine validation from upstream stabilization/26100).
COPR stable channel (broadest audience; tracks tagged upstream releases).

components.name: clang
components.description: Build dependency: the engine compiles with clang (-Werror).

components.name: qt6-qtbase-devel
components.description: System Qt6 build headers/tools (moc/uic/rcc) for the system_qt6 swap. Also qt6-qtbase-private-devel, qt6-qtsvg-devel, qt6-qttools-devel.

components.name: qt6-qtbase-gui
components.description: System Qt6 runtime (Core/Gui/Widgets/Network/Concurrent/Xml/DBus/OpenGL/Test + the xcb platform plugin), plus qt6-qtsvg. REPLACES the custom-patched bundled Qt 5.15 that the 26.05 line shipped -- the Qt Bundling Library Exception is now RESOLVED for the 26.10 line.

components.name: o3de-system-library-swaps
components.description: Stage-1 system-library swaps active on the 26.10 line: bundled 3rdParty replaced by the Fedora system libs assimp, freetype, libpng, zlib, expat, lz4, openexr+imath, SQLite, lua, libsamplerate, google-benchmark, vulkan-validation-layers, mikkelsen. Each is a normal Fedora RPM dependency (auto-Requires the system soname); none are bundled.

licenses.expression: BSD-3-Clause OR Zlib OR MIT OR FTL

components.name: o3de-dependencies
components.description: Fedora-clean COPR rebuilds of 3rdParty packages not (yet) in Fedora, consumed via hellaenergy/o3de-dependencies: o3de2605-dxc-spirv (license-clean SPIR-V-only DXC), o3de2605-mcpp-az, o3de2605-spirv-cross, o3de2605-cityhash. Shared with the 26.05 line (identical 3rdParty versions).

components.name: pyside6
components.description: PySide6 + shiboken6 kept bundled (fetched via packages.o3de.org) even under system Qt6: runtime-only Qt-for-Python bindings built against the engine's bundled CPython 3.10, which the Fedora python3-pyside6 (built for python3.13) cannot substitute until the bundled-Python migration lands (FEDORA_ROADMAP stage 3). Links the system libQt6*.so.6 at runtime.

components.name: openssl
components.description: Bundled by upstream O3DE via packages.o3de.org. END-OF-LIFE since 2023-09-11. Migration to system OpenSSL 3.x is tracked in FEDORA_ROADMAP.md (stage 4); 3p #387 bumped the bundle to 3.6.3 upstream, engine-side pin bump pending.

components.name: o3de-clang-toolchain
components.description: Embedded clang/libclang/libtinfo bundled by O3DE (used by the DXC rebuild)

components.name: o3de-python
components.description: Bundled Python 3.10 venv installed by /opt/O3DE/<DISPLAY_VERSION>/python/get_python.sh into ~/.o3de/Python/venv/<engine-id>. System-Python migration (Fedora 3.13) tracked in FEDORA_ROADMAP stage 3; also gates a system PySide6 swap.

components.name: googletest
components.description: Fetched at cmake configure time via FetchContent (test scaffolding only; LY_DISABLE_TEST_MODULES=ON skips test builds)
